sloka: ताम् एवम् उक्त्वा जननीम् लक्ष्मणम् पुनर् अब्रवीत् ।तव लक्ष्मण जानामि मयि स्नेहम् अनुत्तमम् ॥२-२१-३७॥
transliteration: tām evam uktvā jananīm lakṣmaṇam punar abravīt ।tava lakṣmaṇa jānāmi mayi sneham anuttamam ॥2-21-37॥

translations.english: One who is the best among the knowers of speech and best of all archers, Rama spoke to his mother in this manner and then said to Lakshmana:
